gaps.lead: If Marc hadn't taken up politics, he might have become a famous art historian.
gaps.sentence: If Marc hadn't taken up politics, he might have ___ himself as an art historian.
gaps.hint: become famous = make a ___ for oneself
gaps.explanation: 'Make a name for himself' means become well known.

gaps.answer: can afford this holiday as long
gaps.lead: This holiday is within our price range, provided we don't go to the expensive restaurants in the tourist centre.
gaps.sentence: We ___ as we avoid the expensive restaurants in the tourist centre.
gaps.hint: provided = as long as; within our price range = can afford
gaps.explanation: 'Provided' is rewritten as 'as long as'; 'within our price range' as 'can afford'.

gaps.lead: The guidebook says this bridge is Roman.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally said or believed to be.

gaps.lead: I regret not studying harder at university.
gaps.explanation: 'I regret not doing' = 'I wish I had done' — wish + past perfect for past regrets.

gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.lead: It would be sensible to leave before the traffic builds up.
gaps.sentence: We ___ before the traffic builds up.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be sensible to do' = 'we had better do' — had better + bare infinitive.
